modules.title: 少量生产流量怎样先进入 v2

items.title: 先把潜在影响限制在小范围
items.text: 如果新结账版本直接全量上线，未知问题会同时影响所有请求。先给 v2 分配 5% 流量，其余请求继续走已验证的 v1，团队就能在真实条件下观察新版而不立刻扩大影响。

items.title: 用预先约定的信号决定下一步
items.text: 发布前要写清观察时间、错误率或延迟阈值，以及异常时怎样退回。指标健康才逐步扩大；超过阈值就停止并恢复稳定版。小流量没有报错也不能保证新版不存在其他问题。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: “灰度发布”常被用于泛指分阶段开放，金丝雀发布是其中以少量真实流量验证新版本的具体做法。功能开关控制同一部署版本里的功能路径；金丝雀发布控制新旧版本各自承接多少生产流量，两者可以配合但不是一回事。

lessonPractice.title: 结账服务 v2 已承接 5% 流量，错误率达到 7%，超过 2% 阈值。下一步怎样处理？

options.label: 停止扩大，把 v2 流量退回 v1，并确认错误率和结账成功率恢复
options.feedback: 对。金丝雀已经提供了异常证据，应先限制影响并验证稳定版恢复。

options.label: 继续扩大到 100%，等样本更多以后再判断
options.feedback: 指标已经越过预设门槛，继续扩大只会让更多用户进入异常版本。

options.label: 只要部署任务显示成功，就保持 5% 流量不再处理
options.feedback: 部署成功只说明版本已经运行，不能推翻真实流量下的错误率证据。

en.title: Checkout v2 is serving 5% of traffic, but its error rate reaches 7%, above the 2% threshold. What should happen next?

options.label: Stop expansion, return v2 traffic to v1, and confirm error rate and checkout success recover
options.feedback: Correct. The canary produced failure evidence, so limit impact first and verify recovery on the stable version.

options.label: Expand to 100% anyway and wait for a larger sample
options.feedback: The signal already crossed the agreed threshold; expanding would expose more people to the faulty release.

options.label: Keep 5% traffic indefinitely because the deployment job succeeded
options.feedback: A successful deployment only proves the version is running; it does not override error evidence from real traffic.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请把结账服务 v2 先按 5% 流量做金丝雀发布，观察 15 分钟内的结账错误率和延迟。错误率低于 2% 才扩大；超过阈值就停止发布并把流量退回 v1。完成后告诉我两个版本的实际流量和指标。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Canary checkout v2 at 5% traffic and observe checkout error rate and latency for 15 minutes. Expand only while error rate stays below 2%; above the threshold, stop and return traffic to v1. Report actual traffic and metrics for both versions.

learning.assumes: You know old and new versions of one service can run at the same time.
learning.outcome: You can state a canary's initial traffic, observation signals, expansion gate, and stop action.

modules.title: How a small amount of production traffic reaches v2 first

items.title: Limit possible impact to a small scope
items.text: An all-at-once checkout release exposes every request to unknown defects. Giving v2 5% of traffic while verified v1 keeps the other requests tests the new release under real conditions without immediately widening impact.

items.title: Let agreed signals decide the next step
items.text: Define an observation period, error or latency threshold, and return action before release. Expand only while signals are healthy; stop and restore the stable version above the threshold. A quiet small sample still cannot prove every path is correct.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Progressive or gradual rollout is the broader family; a canary release specifically validates a new version with a small amount of real traffic. A feature flag routes feature paths inside a deployed release, while a canary routes production traffic between release versions. They can work together but are not identical.

distinctions.label: Feature flag
distinctions.text: A {c:canary-release} routes a small share of production traffic to a new release version. A {c:feature-flag} can route selected people to a feature path without changing the deployed version.
